SESOI.derivation: max(structural floor, empirical null p95) over a pre-decisive null calibration

empirical_null.capacity_check: train-fit accuracy 1.000 and single_rule accuracy 1.000 on all 20 seeds
empirical_null.note: Non-binding because the whole null distribution is negative, so it imposes no positive threshold and the structural floor governs.  LIMITATION: trained on a stream whose composition targets are permuted, the candidate is confidently wrong (4-6 nats against uniform log(10)=2.303), so the null is centred far below zero.  It therefore bounds the false-positive tail of the decision statistic but does NOT calibrate its variance in a near-competitive regime.

seed_partition.0-4: design and diagnostics - BURNED, never decisive
seed_partition.100-119: SESOI calibration - consumed by the null run above
seed_partition.200-209: decisive - untouched by every run to date

structural_floor.argument: B6 has a provable floor of log(3) on pair_holdout: closure is vacuous on an unseen marker run, so at most three of six body symbols are excludable.  The smallest discrete competence step above that comparator is excluding one more symbol, i.e. moving from three live candidates to two.  Below this the claim would not correspond to any additional structure recovered.

SESOI.unit: nats of mean NLL on the decisive family, comparator minus candidate, per seed

ablation_semantics.N1: clear external KV only; do not reset weights, retrain, alter probes, or alter recurrent architecture

anti_shortcut_gate.provable_floor: ln(3) ~ 1.0986 for B6 on pair_holdout; closure is vacuous on an unseen marker run

benchmark.name: p1-ln-dec-chain
benchmark.vocabulary: six body values, three markers, one START; no mode, rule-id, separator, or metadata token

comparator.rationale: the corpus makes local-suffix statistics confidently wrong, so 'beats the best baseline' would otherwise be satisfied by an agnostic model
comparator.rule: per seed, the minimum mean NLL over DECISION_COMPARATORS
comparator.subsumes: a separate must-beat-chance gate; B_unif and B1 are members

decision_rule.equivalent_threshold: against B6's provable log(3) floor, a positive result requires candidate mean NLL at or below log(2) ~ 0.6931, i.e. confidently narrowing six body symbols to two
decision_rule.positive: seed-clustered 95% CI lower bound > SESOI, AND candidate mean NLL < SOLVED_NLL, AND B5b (last-marker shortcut) fails
decision_rule.statistic: per seed, min mean NLL over DECISION_COMPARATORS minus candidate mean NLL on the decisive family

dec2_preregistration.dependent_variable: per-item next-token negative log-likelihood on frozen held-out probes
dec2_preregistration.diagnostic_exclusion_reason: value_holdout is reachable to ~0.35 nats by bijection closure on an already-seen marker run, which requires no composition; measured as baseline B6.
dec2_preregistration.independent_variable: presence of the NN-0 candidate learner versus an exposure-matched non-composing model

learner.bptt_window_rationale: the longest DEC-2 episode has four token transitions, so a window of four carries the gradient across the whole episode: binding a two-marker run at positions 1-2 to the value at position 3 spans three transitions and is unreachable at the legacy window of one
learner.truncation_boundary: window >= max episode length on this corpus, so truncation never fires inside an episode; the only detachment point is the episode boundary

dec2_preregistration.primary_metric: mean NLL over the decisive family, per master seed

reported_not_compared.B5a: achievable-learner ceiling: grammar prior plus table induction plus chaining
reported_not_compared.B5b: shortcut adversary: last-marker parse only; must fail

failure_policy.failed_seed: record and block complete decisive classification

memory_settings.external_kv: detached host KV; clear_external_memory clears only KV
memory_settings.learned_weights: TinyGRUCore parameters; never cleared by reset_episode or N1
memory_settings.replay: error-prioritized reservoir; clear_replay clears only replay

metrics.primary: per-item NLL on identical frozen Probe objects
metrics.stored: per-item NLL, family mean, seed-level paired contrast

oracle_semantics.achievable_learner: candidate receives rule components plus explicit per-symbol calibration; decisive combination is withheld
oracle_semantics.candidate_rejection_rule: never reject a candidate solely for failing private random information

probe_definitions.held_out_rule: templates (0,1,2) and (2,0,1) are absent from training; tiny dry-run uses the first only
probe_definitions.identifiability: one target per decisive context; stochastic distributions are not used

statistics.failed_seed_policy: retain failed/diverged seeds and block a complete gate
statistics.primary: mean paired NLL difference baseline minus candidate
statistics.relative: mean paired difference divided by baseline mean NLL

training_exposure.context_target_alignment: target is the final token; internal context transitions are learned in order
training_exposure.episode_boundary: reset recurrent hidden state at each Experience.episode_start
training_exposure.experience_unit: one full START-prefixed context plus one target
training_exposure.exposure_unit: one token transition in the ordered training stream
training_exposure.exposure_unit_rationale: DEC-1 fitted baselines on 11 (context -> final target) rows while NN-0 took 53 gradient steps on the same corpus. Counting transitions is the only unit under which the candidate and every baseline see the identical quantity of data.
training_exposure.truncation_boundary: the hidden state is detached only at a window boundary; within a window the gradient reaches the recurrent weights across every timestep in it
